Authorize only existing period-aligned reconciliation; approve no discretionary spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or new production work. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods are misaligned; infrastructure, domain, labor, and marketing costs are absent; incremental outcomes are not isolated; and monthly spend, marketing, revenue-target, and revenue-floor limits are blank. Minimum measurement: one reconciled period-aligned ledger by site and page covering revenue, affiliate attribution, AI, infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, experiment exposure, and incremental outcomes. Do not treat missing telemetry as zero or use impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, technical scores, or AI call counts as financial return.
